scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace bot
scripts.postinstall: [ "$RENDER" = true ] && npm run build --workspace backend || true
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace bot
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.verify: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck && npm run test && VITE_API_URL=${VITE_API_URL:-https://narcos-shop.onrender.com/api} npm run build
